findings.body: For another repo, `local()` returns undefined, so this fallback displays an identifier with punctuation removed instead of the item's recorded title. This affects both drawn surfaces, `/forge` text, selectors and stop confirmations. A concrete producer case exists in `tests/test_lanes_agents.py:166–168`: another current-release repo runs reader `SHOP`, whose title is “Shoppers can save a basket” (`tests/test_fix_agent_runs_wait_in_line.py:54`). `src/forge/story.py:222–231` admits that identifier, and the new lane producer carries no display title. Task identifiers similarly become strings such as “FORGE MOD 1 MACHINE”. Done-when 6 explicitly requires items in plain words. Preserve the local-only enrichment ruling by recording the existing display title in the lane entry alongside its identity, and cover a current-release foreign story/task in the owning tests.
findings.title: Not done: Machine rows name items in plain words

findings.body: Forge's existing runner can publish `{done: 0, total: 0}`: `src/forge/review.py:301–305` accepts `collected 0 items`, and lines 311–332 accept a zero TAP plan and persist its progress. This validator rejects that legitimate producer output, causing the whole Machine refresh to retain stale rows and report malformed output; stop confirmation also rejects the same snapshot. The nullable-progress ruling covered unknown counts, whereas these producer paths record a known zero. Accept zero totals and omit the bar for them, retaining elapsed-only rendering.
findings.title: Accept zero-test progress without rejecting the entire snapshot

stop.reason: Owner accepts: the spinner's place-in-line ships as a separate small fix next; the extra drawing-test coverage is dismissed per the one-test-per-rule direction.
